statement: ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → IsCompact (WaveMap.box n R) ∧ volume (WaveMap.box n R) = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * R) ^ n)
proof:
intro R hR
have he : WaveMap.box n R = (PiLp.homeomorph 2 (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ)) ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ (fun _ => Icc (-R) R) := by
  ext x
  change (∀ j, x j ∈ Icc (-R) R) ↔ (∀ j ∈ (Set.univ : Set (Fin n)), x j ∈ Icc (-R) R)
  simp only [mem_univ, forall_true_left]
constructor
· rw [he]
  exact (PiLp.homeomorph 2 (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ)).isCompact_preimage.mpr (isCompact_univ_pi fun _ => isCompact_Icc)
· have hm : volume ((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin n → ℝ)).symm ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ (fun _ : Fin n => Icc (-R) R)) = volume (Set.pi Set.univ (fun _ : Fin n => Icc (-R) R)) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin n)).measure_preimage_equiv _
  change volume (WaveMap.box n R) = _ at hm
  rw [hm, volume_pi_pi]
  simp only [Real.volume_Icc, sub_neg_eq_add, ← two_mul, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * R) n).symm
